description: This file provides classes and methods for integrating and handling CometAPI's chat completion endpoint, including configuration, request transformation, URL handling, error handling, and streaming response parsing.

classes.name: CometAPIConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for CometAPI, inheriting from OpenAIGPTConfig, handling parameter mapping, URL formation, error handling, and response iteration.

classes.name: CometAPIChatCompletionStreamingHandler
classes.description: Handles streaming chat completion responses from CometAPI, parsing chunks, handling errors, and extracting message choices.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to CometAPI-specific format, allowing for custom extra body parameters.

methods.name: remove_cache_control_flag_from_messages_and_tools
methods.description: Removes cache control flags from messages and tools if not supported by CometAPI.

methods.name: transform_request
methods.description: Transforms request parameters into the final request body for the API call, including extra body data.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for CometAPI, adding /v1/ prefix if missing.

methods.name: get_error_class
methods.description: Returns a CometAPI-specific exception class for errors.

methods.name: get_model_response_iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for streaming responses from CometAPI.
